import 'package:hazard_fixture/lease.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  late Lease lease;
  final shared = Lease();

  setUp(() {
    lease = Lease()..acquire();
    shared.acquire();
  });

  // Throws when the setUp above did not run, or when a mutant took the
  // lease away: a tearDown that fails is a failed test.
  tearDown(() {
    lease.release();
    shared.release();
  });

  test('held', () => expect(lease.free, isFalse));

  test('free after a release, and held again for the tearDown', () {
    lease.release();
    expect(lease.free, isTrue);
    lease.acquire();
  });

  test('the shared one is held by one test at a time', () {
    expect(shared.free, isFalse);
    shared.release();
    expect(shared.free, isTrue);
    shared.acquire();
  });

  test('releasing what is not held throws', () {
    expect(Lease().release, throwsStateError);
  });
}
